notes.title: Development progress in September
notes.notes: [h3]Visual[/h3][p]23new hairstyles & 17new masks[/p][p]Some adjustments to map visuals and character styling[/p][p]7 new filters  [/p][h3]New Buildings[/h3][p]Simple fence:Reliable initial construction, emergency necessities[/p][p]V-wall:Hanging walls to block high-altitude enemies[/p][p]Berry potted plants:Too busy fighting to farm? Potted plants will be a good helper!Magic potted plants that automatically grows GGberries when placed[/p][p]Weapon rack: Place excess weapons[/p][h3]Mysterious[/h3][p]New weapon&refit[/p][p]New enemy[/p][p]5 new plants[/p][h3]Features[/h3][p]Portals, "road signs", and altars are installed[/p][p]Removed the old cumbersome way of obtaining buildings, no longer running back and forth to the initial room, eliminating the process of waiting for production[/p][p]Removed the restrictions on carrying buildings and selecting NPCs from outside[/p][p]Overall balance adjustments [/p][p]More convenient seed access, optimized planting speed, and increased crop drops[/p][p]"Vine Device"[/p][h3]Else[/h3][p]Enrich the backstory and do some concept design  [/p][p]Remastering the newbie guide[/p][h3]Fixes[/h3][p]Fixed an issue where the stacking error was built to control the tiers more precisely  [/p][p]Shark ruler are still working after replacement(this effect will allow Ran to knock through the stone with his/her body, so let's think of it as a dream)[/p][p]Fixed material location not refreshing  [/p][p]Fixed a bug when building previews were destroyed  [/p][p]Fixed a bug when unlocking new monsters  [/p][p]Some text shows failed  [/p][p]Resolved some text flickering issues when refreshing  [/p][p]Avoid mistakes, disable aerial planting/building[/p][p]Door failed[/p][p]Got knocked flying while changing map[/p][p]And Trivial problems[/p]

notes.title: Development progress in August
notes.notes: [h2]Visual[/h2][p]Made a big decision: expanded field of view, now Ran have broader perspective  [/p][p]Added 10 new map decorations 🌿  [/p][p]UI adjustments for upgrade options to accommodate new weapons and refit[/p][p][/p][h2]New Weapons[/h2][p][b]ScarletFoX-890[/b]: A mid-to-close-range shotgun with quad-shot trajectory, a balanced performance piece in the Northland Fire series.  [/p][p][b]"Carrot"[/b]: A mid-range light submachine gun with wide spread. Let your enemies eat carrots! (Why carrot?)  [/p][p][b]Pick Up GGhen[/b]: No one knows if someone sprinting while holding a hen is a good idea, but it happened. The hen will unleash a powerful Cluck! Everyone will revere those who charge into battle while holding a hen!  [/p][p][b]Shark ruler[/b]: A magical boomerang made of black steel, capable of altering its trajectory with telepathy to clear obstacles. "-The reliable buddy always return." [/p][p][/p][h2]New Buildings[/h2][p][b]Twall[/b]:The higher Nwall looks a bit reassuring.[/p][p][b]S-S-R:[/b]Spines-Shell-Rat! Yes,ssrat comes to help you.Hard shell protects them taking only 1 damage at a time, stabbing all the enemies trying who to pass 2 times.[/p][p][b]Unsuspicious Grass pile:[/b] The unsuspicious grassy pile has been summoned.Firstly, it is not suspicious at all, secondly, It definitely doesn't look like a trap.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693850/f8159bf2269becd0000b858bc29a45fa926f04db.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Features[/h2][p]Modified and added some monster enhancement options[/p][p]Enhanced Ran's magic reservoir[/p][p]When you creating monsters, angels may grant weapons[/p][p][/p][h2]Refit[/h2][p]ScarletFoX-890: Add 3 new refit[/p][p]"Carrot":Add 5 new refit[/p][p]Shark ruler:Add 2 new refit[/p][p][/p][h2]Fixes[/h2][p]Performance optimization reduces CPU overhead to a certain extent  [/p][p]Fixed the number of monster summons not being updated based on upgrades, and the wave number was not accumulated  [/p][p]Fixed an error when obtaining a variant weapon  [/p][p]Fixed a missing crash for plant rewards  [/p][p]and a series of fragmentary problems that are difficult to describe[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693850/767f920ad4f2c6f876a4532540f5b8cee013b1f0.png"][/img][/p]
